name: id230
label: ID Quantique ID230 InGaAs/InP SPAD (25 %, 2 us dead time)
sources: ID Quantique ID230 brochure (G.192.0115-PB-1.0, specifications as of June 2026): 900-1700 nm; efficiency 10/15/20/25 % calibrated at 1550 nm; timing jitter 200 ps max, 150 ps typical at 25 %; dead time 2-100 us in 1 us steps; dark count < 80 Hz at 10 % and < 200 Hz at 20 % (50 us dead time, -90 C); LVTTL 100 ns output; fibre input SMF or MMF 62.5 um; 30 kg module
notes: Set at the 25 % efficiency level with the shortest dead time (2 us); dark 200 cps is the 20 % figure (the 25 % level will be somewhat higher).

The PDE is calibrated at 1550 nm only: the fall to 0.10 at 900 nm (the InP window edge, ~925 nm) and the curve between are ASSUMED; the 0.001 floor below 850 nm is not a claim of visible sensitivity, it exists only because the PDE table is clamped outside its range.

max_total_cps 2.5e5 is an OPERATING CAP, not a device limit: half of 1/dead time, so the non-paralyzable dead-time model (r/(1 + r tau), detected 1.7e5 cps at load 0.5) stays trustworthy; the runners attenuate brighter stars to it as a neutral-density filter would. Every giant brighter than H ~ 1 therefore gives the same count rate and the same S/N.
